title: Report: Conversation-Practice Sessions
prompt:
You have been asked by the director of studies at the language school where you study to write a report assessing the effectiveness of the school's current conversation-practice sessions and recommending improvements.

Write your report in 280-320 words.
notes: C2 bar: precise, formal register sustained throughout; well-chosen headings that organise genuinely distinct content rather than padding; recommendations that follow clearly and specifically from evidence/points raised earlier in the report, not generic suggestions; natural use of more formal/academic structures (e.g. nominalisation, passive voice where appropriate) without sounding stilted.
